mapper.sql: select ec.id, ec.system_id, es.system_name, ec.category_id, ecg.category_name, ec.code, ec.message, ec.description, ec.severity_id, esv.severity_code, esv.severity_name, ec.status, ec.version, ec.del_flag, ec.create_by, ec.create_time, ec.update_by, ec.update_time from error_code ec left join error_system es on es.id = ec.system_id and es.del_flag = 0 left join error_category ecg on ecg.id = ec.category_id and ecg.system_id = ec.system_id and ecg.del_flag = 0 left join error_severity esv on esv.id = ec.severity_id and esv.del_flag = 0
mapper.select: select ec.id, ec.system_id, es.system_code, es.system_name, es.description as system_description, ec.category_id, ecg.category_code, ecg.category_name, ecg.description as category_description, ec.code, ec.message, ec.description, ec.severity_id, esv.severity_code, esv.severity_name, ec.status, ec.version from error_code ec inner join error_system es on es.id = ec.system_id and es.status = 1 and es.del_flag = 0 inner join error_category ecg on ecg.id = ec.category_id and ecg.system_id = ec.system_id and ecg.status = 1 and ecg.del_flag = 0 inner join error_severity esv on esv.id = ec.severity_id and esv.status = 1 and esv.del_flag = 0 where ec.status = 1 and ec.del_flag = 0 order by es.system_code, ecg.category_code, ec.code
